agreements: M0 is limited to model-free CPU instrument conformance and cannot establish learning, DREAM authorship, LoRA transport, online learning, accumulation, lifetime improvement, or a complete-organism result.
A later M-TEXT assay may at most test causal use of externally supplied grounded connected text by one fixed model under separately frozen model-facing and inferential contracts.
Environment roots are the maximum scientific units for a later M-TEXT assay; aliases, order variants, goals, paths, calls, branches, cells, and reruns are repeated measures.
V7 byte identity and successful local symbolic checks do not transfer V7 authority, failed-scope-audit status, scientific meaning, or successor permission to PCFL.

Paired-prefix visibility, chronological provenance, transform specificity, root reduction, and independent review are necessary ingredients, but the supplied proposal does not bind them at the required exactness.
No consensus, CPU receipt, or future human decision based on this artifact authorizes implementation, fixture generation, model execution, GPU work, or scientific claims.

concern_dispositions.required_change: Keep V7 as design reference only until a successor binds every consumed primitive, input, output, compatibility witness, five-file hash, oracle firewall, and explicit PCFL scope authorization.

concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind an independently derived invariant or oracle basis, disjoint checker lineage, and mutation cases; otherwise describe manifest agreement only as reproducibility.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. M0 semantic noninterference does not prove noninterference of rendered model-visible state.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. The proposed general prohibition is not an operational query/agenda law.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind command grammar, legal public anchors, catalog, cursor, order, padding, returned-ID capability table, and exhaustive mutations denying goal/private/arm/score-conditioned agenda selection.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. The canonical join projection and rejection surface are absent.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind canonical GOALS_COMPLETE bytes, a complete join allowlist, and rejection mutations for every abandoned or sibling trace, workspace, dependency, correctness, failure, ordering, and padding field.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. Hidden repeat state changes legal policy behavior.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind actor-visible repeat fingerprints, counts, block status, reset reasons, prompt projection, and exhaustive replay/progress/reset transitions.

concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind every destroyed and retained state across reset, the new-record admission point, and the sole permitted old-plus-new channel; test denial of raw history, transcripts, caches, provider state, and environment-state bypasses.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. The vocabulary does not bind relation-specific executable admission semantics.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind node identity, edge direction, alias-collapse order, root equivalence, admission/revocation and contradiction precedence, plus legal-diamond, true-cycle, descendant, and synthetic-evidence fixtures.

concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind answer-neutral row production, identity/order/lexical/citation controls, registered path-equivalence scoring, and recurrent behavioral dependence rather than decorative dependency IDs.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted. Fixed topology and omitted target-only control leave shortcut and generalization interpretations open.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind target-only and answer-prior controls plus held-out factorial splits across goals, worlds, aliases, answers, path alternatives, and carrier variants.

disagreements.issue: Whether the proposal is exact enough for the requested ratification and scoped implementation.

positions.position: A deterministic post-ratification materialization loop can freeze the needed finite universe and manifest.
The absent universe, transition, fixture, checker, and handoff bytes determine semantics and cannot be ratified prospectively.

resolution.rationale: Select the critique position. The proposal requests ratification of exact bytes that it does not supply; a future materialization promise cannot make the present packet exact.
resolution.required_change: Rework with complete canonical bytes and hashes before requesting ratification or implementation.

disagreements.issue: Whether the registered required_before labels define a possible fail-closed workflow.

positions.position: CPU conformance is required before implementation and M-TEXT causal evidence before model execution.
Those receipts are produced respectively by implementation and model execution, so the labels are impossible.

resolution.rationale: Select the benchmark/critique position. Staging must distinguish pre-implementation specification validation, post-implementation CPU conformance, pre-model review/handoff gates, and post-execution claim evidence.
resolution.required_change: Rework the acceptance-stage order in successor bytes.

disagreements.issue: Whether a new graph edge and byte identity authorize V7 primitive reuse in PCFL.

positions.position: A PCFL-specific reuse edge under new authority can consume mapped byte-identical V7 primitives.
The mapping and explicit successor scope authorization are absent; V7 terminal authority and failed audit cannot transfer.

resolution.rationale: Select the systems/critique position. Mapping language without a primitive table and explicit human scope authorization is not authority.
resolution.required_change: Keep V7 reference-only until a successor binds and authorizes the exact reuse boundary.

disagreements.issue: Whether two checkers reproducing a manifest root prove the claimed independent semantic validation.

positions.position: Two independently derived checkers reproduce the root and falsify a self-consistent single materializer.
Shared derivation assumptions can preserve the same semantic error; agreement alone proves reproducibility only.

resolution.rationale: Select the interpretations. Independence must be operationally bound through disjoint lineage and independently derived invariants or oracle material.
resolution.required_change: Rework with an independent semantic checker and mutation evidence.

disagreements.issue: Whether M0's optional separately ratified preparation boundary freezes a model-facing handoff sufficiently.

positions.position: Renderer, tokenizer, and cut inputs may be supplied through a separately ratified preparation boundary.

positions.position: Unless all output-affecting rendering and session choices are exactly bound before execution, later choices redesign the instrument and can leak treatment information.

resolution.rationale: Select the interpretations/critique position. A separate boundary is permissible only when it is exact, immutable, and identified by the accepted handoff before M-TEXT execution.

resolution.rationale: Select the critique position. The semantic target is sound, but the operative schemas and falsifiers are absent.
resolution.required_change: Rework with exact query, join, repeat, reset, and actor-visible-state contracts plus dedicated missing tests.

disagreements.issue: Whether the stated reset and provenance principles identify the delayed-memory channel and support semantics.

positions.position: Reset behavior and provenance properties are covered by M0 conformance and the provenance/intervention test.
State destruction/retention and relation-specific admission, root equivalence, revocation, and precedence are not exact.

resolution.rationale: Select the critique position. The existing tests name the right areas but cannot falsify the unspecified behavior.
resolution.required_change: Rework with exact reset-channel and provenance semantics and dedicated missing tests.

disagreements.issue: Whether supplied rows, carrier controls, and current baselines rule out answer/path laundering and shortcut priors.

Producer/scorer choices, target-only priors, fixed topology, and missing factorial held-out splits leave direct solution and shortcut routes open.

resolution.rationale: Select the benchmark/critique position. These controls must be prospectively exact before behavioral causal interpretation.
resolution.required_change: Rework with answer-neutral construction, path-equivalence scoring, target-only controls, and registered held-out splits.

disagreements.issue: Whether the proposed M-TEXT tests identify recurrence, resources, and separable mechanisms.

resolution.rationale: Select the benchmark/critique position. Existing tests cannot be silently expanded in consensus; successor registry additions are required.
resolution.required_change: Rework and register distinct recurrence-necessity, resource-factorial, and endpoint-separation tests.

disagreements.issue: Whether the narrow supplied-memory claim can proceed without an exact inference, clean/session, and confirmation contract.

resolution.required_change: Rework with explicit clean/session and confirmation edges, inferential contract, mandatory negative dispositions, and a separate future online-learning assay for broader claims.
